{{Quote|If we had more Jedi like you working the streets, Black Sun would be a thing of the past.|[[Coruscant Security Force/Legends|Coruscant Security]] [[Police officer/Legends|Officer]] [[Stansun]] to a [[Hero of Tython|Jedi Knight]]|<ref name="Star Wars: The Old Republic">''[[Star Wars: The Old Republic]]''</ref>}}
'''Black Sun territory''', also known as the '''Black Sun district''', was a sector of [[Coruscant/Legends|Coruscant]] ruled by the [[Black Sun/Legends|Black Sun]] criminal syndicate in the aftermath of the [[Sacking of Coruscant]]. After the Sacking, [[Coruscant riots (3653 BBY)|rioting]] and chaos overwhelmed the [[Coruscant Security Force/Legends|Coruscant Security Force]] and several prominent gangster began taking neighborhoods in the [[Coruscant Underworld/Legends|lower levels]]. They formed themselves into the Black Sun criminal syndicate and began [[Spice/Legends|spice]] and weapons trafficking. Black Sun's advance to claim more sectors was halted by the [[Justicars' Brigade]] [[Militia/Legends|militia]], however, they continued rioting and plundering within their own territory. Several years into the [[Cold War (Galactic Republic–Sith Empire)|Cold War]], the CSF began making concerted efforts to reclaim the territory including fielding [[special tactical unit]]s.
